result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): The two pages share almost the same layout and copy, and both have the correct plans, prices and features. A highlights Crew more strongly with a dark card, and its 'Everything in Crew, plus:' heading on Yard pushes Yard's feature list out of line with the others. B uses a lighter bordered highlight with dividers that keep the feature lists more even, though its Crew card also sits higher than the other two, and its separate annual pill is a bit detached from the toggle while A puts it inside the toggle. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both pages show the three plans with correct prices and highlight Crew. Only the top 800px of each was visible, so the lower feature lists could not be checked. A is easier to compare: its feature lists start at the same height and the visible items run in the same order, while B's Yard card adds an 'Everything in Crew, plus:' heading that pushes its list down. B's dark Crew card stands out more strongly, but A's lighter accent keeps all three cards balanced.
